display.purpose: Page titles, hero headings. Tight tracking at large sizes.

label.purpose: Buttons, tabs, navigation. Slightly positive tracking.

shadows.name: subtle-lift
shadows.purpose: Card edges, subtle separation at rest.

motion.name: spring-standard
motion.purpose: Critically damped spring for UI transitions. No overshoot.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Green action button for positive actions: create, save, submit.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #238636; color: #ffffff; padding: 5px 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid rgba(63,185,80,0.4); border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: 80ms cubic-bezier(0.33,1,0.68,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2ea043; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #58a6ff; outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Dark background button for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-default { background: #21262d; color: #c9d1d9; padding: 5px 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid #363b42; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: 80ms cubic-bezier(0.33,1,0.68,1); } .ds-btn-default:hover { background: #30363d; border-color: #8b949e; } .ds-btn-default:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-default:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #58a6ff; outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Transparent button with blue text for tertiary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: #58a6ff; padding: 5px 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid #30363d; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: 80ms cubic-bezier(0.33,1,0.68,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: rgba(56,139,253,0.1); border-color: #58a6ff; } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Text input with 6px radius, dark background, blue focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 5px 12px; font-size: 14px; color: #e6edf3; background: #0d1117; border: 1px solid #30363d; border-radius: 6px; outline: none; transition: border-color 80ms, box-shadow 80ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6e7681; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #58a6ff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(56,139,253,0.1); }

components.name: Card (Box)
components.description: Standard card container with border, no shadow at rest.
components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid #30363d; border-radius: 6px; background: #0d1117; } .ds-card-header { padding: 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #e6edf3; border-bottom: 1px solid #30363d; background: #161b22; border-radius: 5px 5px 0 0; } .ds-card-body { padding: 16px; color: #e6edf3; }

components.name: Label (Chip)
components.description: Pill-shaped status label with color variants.
components.css: .ds-label { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 7px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 18px; border-radius: 2em; border: 1px solid transparent; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-label-green { background: rgba(46,160,67,0.1); color: #3fb950; border-color: rgba(46,160,67,0.4); } .ds-label-blue { background: rgba(56,139,253,0.1); color: #58a6ff; border-color: rgba(56,139,253,0.4); } .ds-label-red { background: rgba(248,81,73,0.1); color: #f85149; border-color: rgba(248,81,73,0.4); }

components.name: Navigation Tabs
components.description: Horizontal tab bar with solid background and accent underline on active.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #30363d; background: #0d1117; } .ds-nav-item { padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #e6edf3; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; background: none; border-top: none; border-left: none; border-right: none; cursor: pointer; opacity: 0.7; transition: color 80ms, border-color 80ms; } .ds-nav-item:hover { opacity: 1; border-bottom-color: #30363d; } .ds-nav-item[aria-selected='true'] { opacity: 1; font-weight: 600; border-bottom-color: #58a6ff; }

narrative.overview: CODEHALAAM's visual identity merges GitHub's battle-tested Primer design system with Apple's fluid interface philosophy. The result is a dark-first, high-contrast environment where every interaction feels precise and responsive. Content scrolls under translucent chrome, buttons compress on press, and depth is conveyed through subtle tonal layering rather than heavy shadows.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first with full light theme support
Apple fluid motion (Framer Motion springs, not CSS transitions)
Translucent material toolbar with backdrop blur
High-contrast text on dark backgrounds (WCAG AA compliant)
GitHub Primer component vocabulary (Buttons, Labels, Boxes, UnderlineNav)

rules.name: The Contrast Floor Rule
rules.body: Body text must meet WCAG AA (4.5:1). Large text must meet 3:1. No exception for aesthetic preference.

rules.name: The Accent Rarity Rule
rules.body: The primary accent appears on ≤15% of any given screen. Its rarity is what makes it meaningful.

rules.name: The Optical Sizing Rule
rules.body: Tracking is size-specific: tightened for display text, relaxed for small text.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state.

dos: Do use var(--color-text-primary) for all body text
Do use scale(0.97) on button press for instant tactile feedback
Do use translucent material treatment only on the toolbar
Do use the UnderlineNav component for tab navigation
Do ensure every text color meets WCAG AA contrast
donts: Don't use gradient text — emphasis comes from weight or size
Don't use heavy drop shadows on cards
Don't place text over cover images without a solid background
Don't use var(--color-fg-subtle) for body text
Don't add decorative borders above 1px on cards
